block.createbigcannons.mortar_stone.tool: This mortar stone can be fired with a maximum of _3_ powder charges

Powerful stone that _explodes on impact._ _Flies further_ than other projectiles. Good for attacking _walls and fortifications._ _Cannot be fuzed and detonated._ Will _break_ if fired with too much propellant.
